description: Source code for a Debugger class managing debugging state and events within a browser automation context, including pause/resume functionality and event handling.

classes.name: Debugger
classes.description: A class that manages debugging state, including pausing, resuming, and event emission for debugging sessions.

methods.name: setMuted
methods.description: Sets the muted state to suppress or allow debugging actions.

methods.name: onBeforeCall
methods.description: Handles logic before a call, potentially pausing execution based on conditions.

methods.name: onBeforeInputAction
methods.description: Handles logic before an input action, potentially pausing execution.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses execution, records pause start time, and emits pause event.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes execution from pause, resolving all paused call promises.

methods.name: pauseOnNextStatement
methods.description: Sets the debugger to pause on the next statement.

methods.name: isPaused
methods.description: Checks if the debugger is currently paused.

methods.name: pausedDetails
methods.description: Returns details of all paused call metadata and associated SDK objects.
